findings: All three PMU-capable Intel 6975P-C hosts reproduce AArch64 raw cycle cost around +1.9 to +2.1 percent with essentially unchanged retired instructions and branches.
AArch64 raw branch misses fall around 0.9 percent, excluding increased branch-miss count as an explanation of this loss.
L1D and iTLB changes do not consistently explain the loss. Generic cache-misses remain zero, and their ratios are unavailable, not zero or infinite.
This establishes a native layout cost for the frozen iterator intervention; it does not identify the exact frontend mechanism.
